pages.title: Extracellular Matrix
pages.text: The scaffolding cells are built on: a gel of sugar-proteins strung with collagen. Found everywhere in Inner Space, under its tissue. The Chemical Reactor draws Matrix Fibre out of it; eight cobblestone and a fibre make more.

Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Inner Space.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Bone Matrix, Cell Membrane, Chromatin, Collagen Seam, Lymph Tissue, Matrix Fibre, Nucleotide Cluster, Tumour Mass.
